g.text: Design for a reviewed financial work product
Completion includes evidence, correction, constraints and the next decision.
Define what a reviewer would accept before measuring productivity.Contour described comparing research with and without AI, includingsources and conclusions. A useful idea does not demonstrate alpha.

An agent drafts while a planner serves another client; the planner thenreviews and adjusts. Include missing facts and corrections in completion.Parallel work creates a capacity hypothesis; no measured net gain was captured.

Follow a claim through source passages, calculations, tables and chartsinto the document people share. Polished formatting does not establishthat the financial interpretation or underlying evidence is correct.
Sources: Contour, Range and OpenAI attendee accounts. “Reviewed work product” is our common framing, not a verified benefit claim.
